verified_facts.text: ME Lisbon is a few steps from Parque Eduardo VII and the boutiques of Avenida da Liberdade.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in a prime area, just a few steps from Parque Eduardo VII and the boutiques of Avenida da Liberdade.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 0.3 km from Marques de Pombal.
verified_facts.excerpt: 0.3 km from Marquês de Pombal

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have contemporary design, with panoramic views of Lisbon's historic neighbourhoods and monuments.
verified_facts.excerpt: ME Lisbon awaits you with spacious rooms and suites of contemporary design with incredible panoramic views of Lisbon's historic neighbourhoods and monuments.

verified_facts.text: The Attiko Rooftop Pool Bar is on the 13th floor and offers 360-degree views of Lisbon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Attiko Rooftop Pool Bar, located on the 13th floor, offers 360° views of Lisbon.

verified_facts.text: The Attiko rooftop pool bar area remains closed during the winter season.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that the restaurant will remain closed during the winter season.

verified_facts.text: Attiko serves Japanese robata, creative sushi and pan-Asian fusion cuisine with views of Marques de Pombal square and the city centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Attiko, every dish is a spectacle: Japanese robata, creative sushi and pan-Asian fusion cuisine combine with craft cocktails and amazing views of the Plaza del Marqués de Pombal and the city centre.

verified_facts.text: Fismuler celebrates honest cooking with curated ingredients and natural fermentation in a raw, elegant space.
verified_facts.excerpt: This restaurant in Lisbon celebrates honest cooking: curated ingredients, quiet technique, bold flavours and natural fermentation in a raw, elegant space.

verified_facts.text: KORPO Spa offers a sauna, steam room, sensory shower and an indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in the sauna, steam room or sensory shower, and enjoy a swim in the 35m² indoor pool.

verified_facts.text: KORPO Spa offers Thalion and Scens wellness treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy our exclusive facilities and Thalion and Scens wellness treatments.

verified_facts.text: KORPO Spa has two treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our two treatment rooms also offer personalised experiences

verified_facts.text: Through The Culture Collective, the hotel's spaces become a living exhibition with immersive events by artists from Lisbon's cultural scene.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel's spaces transform into a living, dynamic exhibition. Creative and immersive events by artists from the city's cultural scene, offering a unique and contemporary way to experience Lisbon.

verified_facts.text: Elsa Rebelo's ceramic pieces are displayed in the rooms and suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elsa Rebelo’s ceramic pieces transform rooms and suites into intimate, expressive spaces where form meets emotion.

verified_facts.text: Fernanda Fragateiro's site-specific sculpture Wave evokes the River Tejo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Composed of vertical painted steel modules, the piece traces a silent rhythm of interrupted waves, evoking the presence of the River Tejo in Lisbon.

verified_facts.text: Superior ME rooms include local art, a selection of art and fashion books, CO-Bigelow toiletries and coffee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expect local art, a selection of art and fashion books, CO‑Bigelow toiletries, and coffee to elevate your stay.

verified_facts.text: The Extra ME+ Junior Suite with Terrace has a spacious terrace with Kettal outdoor furniture.
verified_facts.excerpt: An exclusive suite with a spacious terrace for relaxing, equipped with Kettal outdoor furniture.

verified_facts.text: Booking a ME+ room or suite includes a complimentary round-trip airport transfer and a complimentary destination experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Such as complimentary airport transfer (round trip), a hydrating mask application on the hands or feet included in your treatment, and a complimentary destination experience.

verified_facts.text: The gym is available 24/7.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our gym, available 24/7 and equipped with state-of-the-art technology, has been designed for those who live without limits.

verified_facts.text: Guests can book a stay with their dog by adding the pet-friendly service, available on request at an additional cost.
verified_facts.excerpt: To book a stay with your dog, please select your Room, rate and add the pet-friendly service (available on request and at an additional cost).

verified_facts.text: Guests have free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, guests staying at the hotel have free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.

verified_facts.text: ME Lisbon was an official partner of Lisbon Design Week, May 27 to 31, 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: As official partners of Lisbon Design Week, we are part of the cultural scene programme taking place from May 27th to 31st, 2026.
